authoritativeMappings.originalSynthesis: A threshold-weaver with a shield-like cephalothorax, split wedge abdomen, eight independently articulated hooked legs, and a one-time inward snare action.

sourceLimitations: Each available source image is a single in-game view rather than a turnaround, model file, UV sheet, or texture source. The Illusion Spider cover was present in the page HTML even though the semantic page view omitted the image link. No missing view was inferred from another creature.

noCopyBoundary.statement: The wiki pages and images were used only for human visual inspection. Only broad body category, massing, palette family, and one simple signature cue per creature were retained. No source image, geometry, texture layout, or pixel pattern was incorporated into the concept artwork.
excludedFromTransfer: source pixel layouts and texture patterns
models, geometry, pivots, hierarchy, and animation
noCopyBoundary.independentModelContract: The shared illusion language is limited to sparse cyan and bruise-violet surface-edge color glints. Illusion Creeper, Illusion Spider, and Illusion Zombie must each receive an independent future geometry, hierarchy, UV layout, animation implementation, and test contract with no shared Warlockery rig, geometry builder, or animation helper.
